ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, C is a point on $\odot O$, and a tangent to $\odot O$ through point C intersects the extension of AB at point E. If $\angle A=30^\circ$, what is the value of $\sin E$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OC, \\
$\because$ CE is a tangent of $\odot$O, \\
$\therefore$ OC$\perp$CE, \\
$\because$ $\angle$A=30$^\circ$, and OC=OA, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$BOC=2$\angle$A=60$^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$E=90$^\circ$−$\angle$BOC=30$^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\sin\angle$E=$\sin30^\circ$= \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}.
